thread:
Ivy Martinez: dropping a concise pass for the landing page rows + the launch/social/webinar routing. Need one clear path per persona: Hosted (developers / prototypes), Dedicated (platforms / predictable SLAs), Private deployment (regulated / on-prem). Draft copy: https://drive.google.com/mock-landing-suite
Rafael Gomez: nice. Two immediate asks: 1) every CTA should seed a hidden field `deployment_type` so we can route leads, 2) attach a 1-line benchmark under each hero card (including test model + seq) so social posts have defensible claims.
June Park: CTA proposals: Hosted -> "Start free API trial" (self-serve), Dedicated -> "Estimate reserved capacity" (lead form), Private -> "Schedule secure deployment demo". Webinar CTA -> "Join: From prototype to production".
Caleb Wright: Routing sketch for ops / growth (HubSpot):
```
/landing?pick=hosted -> form: trial-hosted (hidden: deployment_type=hosted, utm=launch_suite)
/landing?pick=dedicated -> form: lead-dedicated (fields: expected_peak_rps, model_family, desired_commit)
/landing?pick=private -> form: enterprise-sales (fields: compliance_needs, onprem_required, kms_yesno)
/webinar/register -> nurture:webinar-prod-readiness
```
Map to SFDC: trial-hosted -> PLG queue, lead-dedicated -> AE_dedicated, enterprise-sales -> AE_enterprise_compliance.
Zoe Lin: For Dedicated form please add a small "estimated monthly spend" range so we can triage by deal size. Also include a short checkbox "Need burst capacity?" so sizing team knows to model peak.
Marcus Bell: Benchmarks: I can pull p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens for the three canonical configs (open baseline, quantized, runtime-optimized). I'll add a one-sentence methodology and the model/seq used. ETA Mon AM.
Ivy Martinez: Webinar plan: Day 0 launch hero + bench highlights; Day 3 deep-dive blog on Dedicated sizing; Day 6 webinar (panel: infra eng, product PM, AE). Webinar reg form should ask "Which deployment are you evaluating?" and if they pick Private -> prompt for compliance details and auto-create ticket for Solutions.
Rafael Gomez: Social hooks: short X tests (110-140 chars) -> variant A focuses on speed (Hosted), B on economics (Dedicated), C on compliance (Private). Add LinkedIn longform for Dedicated sizing. Need 3 image treatments: sparkline, capacity heatmap, shield/network graphic.
June Park: Microcopy tweaks (suggested):
- Hosted hero subline: "API access in minutes — ideal for prototypes and rapid pilots."
- Dedicated hero subline: "Reserved GPU pools with predictable latency and autoscale options."
- Private hero subline: "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) with KMS, audit logs, and enterprise SLAs."
Avoid the single word "Private" on public pages; use the full label.
Caleb Wright: One nuance on routing: hub forms don't pass complex nested fields well. Use simple scalar fields: `deploy_type`, `peak_rps`, `budget_range`, `compliance_flags` (comma-separated). Then map via middleware to SFDC. I'll draft the middleware spec.
Zoe Lin: UX ask: on Dedicated CTA modal, offer two paths — Quick estimate (3 fields) vs Deep sizing (schedule call). That will reduce AE load and improve conversion. Also A/B test CTA copy: "Estimate capacity" vs "Reserve compute".
Marcus Bell: Note for benchmark cards: always show model name, seq length, and test date. Example microcopy: "Tested with open-medium, 2k seq; avg of 5 runs; quantized variant shown." We'll footnote the test rig.
Ivy Martinez: Action items: 
- Marcus: benchmark numbers + 3 microcards + methodology blurb (due Mon 10am)
- June: finalize CTAs + microcopy + webinar gating questions (due Mon)
- Caleb: middleware spec + hub form field list + SFDC mapping (due Tue)
- Rafael: social variants + image notes (due Tue)
- Zoe: design A/B CTA experiments + CTA modal UX copy (due Tue)
I'll open the landing copy PR after CTAs locked. Scheduling a 20m async review Tue afternoon. Ping if blocked.
June Park: small copy note: for Hosted microcopy avoid claims like "lowest latency" unless benchmark supports it. Use measured language (e.g., "low-latency for common pilot workloads").
Rafael Gomez: also recommend we tag webinar registrants with `interest:hosted/dedicated/private` so follow-ups are tailored. And for webinar gating, add a checkbox "I'd like a pre-webinar sizing consult" (creates task for Solutions).
Ivy Martinez: great. If Ops needs field name changes, loop Caleb and drop the final mapping into the PR. Thanks all :party_popper:
